choose.when: SELECT p.post_id AS target_id, p.writer_id AS reported_member_id FROM post p JOIN members m ON m.member_id = p.writer_id WHERE p.post_id = #{targetId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND m.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT c.comment_id AS target_id, c.writer_id AS reported_member_id FROM comment c JOIN members m ON m.member_id = c.writer_id WHERE c.comment_id = #{targetId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND m.deleted_at IS NULL
choose.otherwise: SELECT m.member_id AS target_id, m.member_id AS reported_member_id FROM members m WHERE m.member_id = #{targetId} AND m.deleted_at IS NULL

mapper.select: SELECT case_id FROM report_case WHERE report_type = #{reportType} AND target_id = #{targetId} AND status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY case_id DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO report_case (report_type, target_id, reported_member_id) VALUES (#{reportType}, #{targetId}, #{reportedMemberId})
INSERT INTO member_report (case_id, reporter_id, reason) VALUES (#{caseId}, #{reporterId}, #{reason})
